$comment: SM037 (Demiton, Delegation of Authority): what kind of sign-off an obligation's evidence needs. Exactly six, fixed by Demiton: an organisation maps each class to its own approval ladder and cannot add a class. The fixed list is half of the cap on DoA complexity.
geotechnical: Ground, compaction and earthworks results: a geotechnical engineer's sign-off.
quality: Conformance, nonconformance, as-built and quality records: the quality or site manager's sign-off.
safety_environment: Work health and safety, environmental and heritage approvals and notices, plant, vehicles and the people who operate them.
variations_claims: Delay, extension of time, variation and latent condition notices and claims: the contract's time-barred entitlements.
payments: Payment claims, schedules, adjudication, retention, security, levies, wages and cost against budget: money in or out.
general: Everything else: own commitments, insurance notifications and records that fit no class above.
